description: Retrieve the full metadata record for a specific LOC digital item. Returns contributors, subjects, summary, languages, locations, rights information, physical description, call number, original and online formats, access restrictions, former catalog IDs, notes, related items, and links to digital resources (TIFF, JPEG, PDF) for items with digital surrogates. Use after libofcongress_search on a result whose is_item is true. Pass the result id verbatim — it may be a simple ID or a slash-separated newspaper path; do not prepend the loc.gov URL. Non-item results (is_item: false) — collections, exhibits, guides, newspaper pages — have no item record and cannot be retrieved here.

item_id.description: LOC item id from a libofcongress_search result's "id" field (where is_item is true). A simple ID ("2009632251", "2005691065") or a slash-separated path for newspaper pages ("sn95047246/1935-09-05/ed-1"). Pass the id verbatim; do not prepend the loc.gov URL or an "item/" prefix.

name: libofcongress_get_item

access_restricted.description: True when LOC restricts access to the original. Absent when upstream omits it.

call_number.description: LOC call number — the shelf location for requesting the physical original.

contributors.description: Contributors, creators, or photographers as LOC catalogs them, role included (e.g., "Washington, George, 1732-1799 (Author)"). One person can appear once per role. Empty when LOC lists none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `item_not_found`: No item exists for the given ID. `rate_limit_exceeded`: LOC API rate limit exceeded; requests are blocked for approximately 1 hour. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

former_ids.description: Superseded catalog identifiers or URLs this item was previously known by.

item_id.description: LOC item ID as resolved by the service (matches the input item_id).

locations.description: Places the item depicts or originates from (e.g., "united states").

notes.description: Descriptive notes and annotations from catalogers.

online_formats.description: Formats the digitized surrogate is available in (e.g., "image").

original_formats.description: Material types of the original (e.g., "photo, print, drawing").

physical_description.description: Physical or technical description of the original item.

related_items.description: IDs or URLs of related LOC records for follow-up retrieval; a title stands in for a related record LOC gives neither for.

resource_links.description: URLs to downloadable digital files (TIFF, JPEG, PDF). Empty when no digital surrogate exists.

rights_information.description: Rights and reproduction statement for this item.

subject_headings.description: LCSH subject headings assigned to this item.

summary.description: Cataloger's abstract of the item's subject and historical context.

title: Get LOC Item
